sections.title: The Science of Infrastructure
sections.body: Kenya AI Compute is built on a foundation of data and rigorous analysis. Our research department continuously monitors global energy trends, GPU lifecycle economics, and the growth of decentralized compute protocols. We publish our findings in a series of whitepapers designed for both technical architects and institutional investors. These documents provide the 'why' behind our strategic decisions—such as our choice of modular design, our 30/50/20 hardware mix, and our focus on the Kenyan energy market. By sharing this knowledge, we aim to establish ourselves not just as a facility provider, but as a thought leader in the creation of sustainable, equitable digital infrastructure for the Global South. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
